This estimate is uncertain, and a recession or a sharp rate shock could produce a negative outcome.

The distribution is very wide, with a realistic downside of -40% or worse if the AI-spend and rate-easing views fail together, and a large upside if several recoveries occur at once. This is a point estimate under substantial uncertainty and is not a guarantee.

This is plausible if rates remain restrictive and the earnings-broadening and build-out theses hold, but it is only a central estimate: a recession early in the period or a valuation de-rating could push the outcome well below zero, and a strong rally in growth stocks could push it well above this level. This is a point estimate under substantial uncertainty and is not a guarantee.
